# Terrastorage 1.3.2 for Minecraft 1.20 and 1.20.1

## Version 1.3.2
A small bugfix release taking care of some issues.

### Fabric Loader
- Fixed a bug that could cause recent versions of Terrastorage (1.3.0 & 1.3.1) to crash the client on startup if the Fabric Loader version was below 0.19.5.

### Sinytra Connector
Fixed the following crashes when Terrastorage was run on NeoForge via Sinytra Connector:
- Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash on startup, affecting version **1.21.1** of Minecraft.
- Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash when opening of an inventory/container (#62), affecting version **1.21.1** of Minecraft.
- Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash on startup on version **26.1.2** of Minecraft.

### Quick Stack To Nearby Storages
- Fixed a small bug that caused the flying items animation to be triggered even when no items were actually transferred.
